title: Prompting for Multimodal Hateful Meme Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to detect race-targeted multimodal hateful memes by classifying the content and explicitly predicting race as the target group using masked prompt templates.
Evaluating the model's ability to detect religion-targeted multimodal hateful memes by classifying the content and explicitly predicting religion as the target group using masked prompt templates.
Evaluating the model's ability to detect sex/gender-targeted multimodal hateful memes by classifying the content and explicitly predicting sex as the target group using masked prompt templates.

Evaluating the model's ability to detect nationality-targeted multimodal hateful memes by classifying the content and explicitly predicting nationality as the target group using masked prompt templates.

Evaluating the model's ability to detect disability-targeted multimodal hateful memes by classifying the content and explicitly predicting disability as the target group using masked prompt templates.
